title: CIA's secret torture programme: New files reveal more accounts of waterboarding claims
content: Recent declassified documents indicate that the CIA possibly engaged in waterboarding practices on more detainees than they have publicly acknowledged. A former translator disclosed witnessing such an interrogation of a detainee in Afghanistan. While the CIA has only confirmed waterboarding for three notable detainees, serious concerns linger about the safety of the torture documentation. Investigations into these practices are ongoing, revealing more about the use of recorded methods during interrogations.

title: 'Very strange': Zelenskyy questions Trump's Putin bonhomie, US support for Ukraine

title: Ohio lawyer denied partnership wins $2m discrimination award after 9-year suit

This decision corroborates the jury's findings of sex discrimination and contract breaches at The Becker Law Firm.

title: 'Hard to believe': Ex-India cricketer questions Siraj's continued omission

title: Taj Mahal marble slab taken by East India Company officer to be auctioned in London
content: A remarkable piece of history, a marble slab from the iconic Taj Mahal, is scheduled to be auctioned on December 9 in the UK. This exquisite slab was taken over 200 years ago by Colonel Pownoll Phipps during the British Raj and was recently uncovered during restoration works. Adorned with delicate carvings and semi-precious stones, it mirrors the floral motifs found on Shah Jahan's cenotaph.

title: Father-son team in South Africa sets 408mph record with 3D-printed drone

title: Odisha women turn banana waste into 21,000 festival boats and extra income
